sentences.text: The defect behind INC-20260314-07 was fixed in the hotfix released on 2026-03-19, which is listed in the release notes between v3.4.0 and v3.3.2 and is described as a hotfix for the dispatch outage in INC-20260314-07.
The defect was a connection pool leak in the dispatch service that was introduced in v3.3.1.
Connections that timed out while a robot was switching access points were not returned to the pool, so the pool slowly shrank.
The leak came from a refactoring of the reconnect logic in v3.3.1, shipped on 24 February 2026.
The fix makes connections that time out while a robot switches access points get returned to the pool (LUM-4851).
